harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 with AlmaLinux’s Apache HTTP Server on TCP 8080. `/cgi-bin/report` executes the supplied script and returns its original text output, `public/` is served at `/`, and private/application files remain unpublished. Configuration and data survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the distribution-supported Apache HTTP Server and SELinux utilities without changing the OS release or kernel
Configured `public/` as the document root and the supplied report as an executable CGI endpoint
Applied persistent SELinux labels for static content and CGI execution
Enabled Apache at boot and opened TCP 8080 in runtime and permanent firewalld configuration
Verified exact static and report output, protected-path isolation, asset hashes, and configuration syntax
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and all functionality recovered

evidence.requirement: Serve the legacy-compatible web service on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and active, listens on `*:8080`, and firewalld allows 8080/tcp both at runtime and permanently.

evidence.requirement: Execute `/cgi-bin/report` while preserving its business output
evidence.summary: The supplied POSIX script and expected values were identified, then HTTP requests returned `Content-Type: text/plain`, `warehouse=west`, and `open_orders=7` before and after restart.

Requests to `/` returned the supplied `

Warehouse reports

` page before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep application source and `private/` outside published content
evidence.summary: Private source, handover configuration, and non-aliased CGI paths returned HTTP 404. SELinux contexts expose only the public tree and executable report to Apache; `private/` retains its non-HTTP context.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release, kernel, and staged data
evidence.summary: The system remained AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel `5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64`; pre/post-restart hashes for the report, index, and private source match.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery of node1
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID `15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9`; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID `2b24f016-d425-4534-9ef8-c2c329bcf761`; Apache, firewall, listener, content, CGI output, protected paths, data hashes, SELinux labels, and syntax all recovered successfully.
